submittedInput.content: A caller says do not tell me your password or any code. Instead, open your banking app and approve the Digital Token sign-in request I just triggered so I can reverse a fee. I did not start any sign-in or ask this caller for help.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason: Sharing an account code or password can let someone access your account.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified.

evidence.title: Keep banking credentials private
evidence.detail: DBS advises against giving another person banking credentials, one-time passwords or Digital Token approvals. This source concerns account authentication; it does not classify ordinary parcel-collection codes. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.

requestedActions.quote: open your banking app and approve the Digital Token sign-in request I just triggered

missingContext: Did you start this request yourself?
